name: Inu no Ongaeshi
source:
Somewhat based off of the Japanese folk story, "Tsuru no Ongaeshi," also known as "The Crane Wife."
In "Inu no Ongaeshi," you play a lonely freelance writer, if, with your lack of motivation, you can even call yourself that. One morning, you meet an injured dog in the forest- rather, a dog girl. A magical, evolving, speed-writing, food-conjuring, future seeing dog girl.
Good luck with that. 

[From [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-24/?action=preview&uid=15672]Ludum Dare[/url]]
translation:
本作在一定程度上取材于日本民间故事《鹤之报恩》，也就是“鹤妻”的传说。

在《犬之报恩》中，你将扮演一名孤独的自由撰稿人——如果凭你的干劲还能称自己为撰稿人的话。一天早晨，你在森林里遇到一只受伤的狗，更准确地说，是一名狗女孩。她会施展魔法、不断进化、快速写作、凭空变出食物，还能预见未来。

祝你好运。

[来自[url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-24/?action=preview&uid=15672]Ludum Dare[/url]]
